children: Raj will lead rewards and performance for India and Global Business Services, bringing experience across compensation strategy, benefits management, HR analytics and technology-enabled HR processes

Renjini Raj has been elevated to Head of Rewards and Performance – India and Global Business Services at Diageo India, expanding her responsibilities in the organisation’s rewards and performance function.

Raj brings extensive experience in total rewards, compensation and benefits, salary benchmarking, HR analytics, policy development and HR technology initiatives. Her expertise spans compensation planning, benefits administration, global compliance and HR process automation.

During her professional journey, she has worked with organisations including Diageo India, HARMAN International, Manhattan Associates, IGATE, Tech Mahindra and Infosys Technologies, building experience across compensation strategy and HR operations.

In her new role, Raj will focus on rewards and performance for the India business and Global Business Services, supporting the organisation’s approach to compensation, employee benefits and performance management.
